tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grib ma khrus sel gyi nyams len bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ya/ gsung ngag rin po che glegs bam pod ser ma na bzhugs pa'i grib ma khrus sel gyi nyams len la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar rten khebs sogs gzhi bzang por 'bru bkram steng bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang de'i mtshon pa'i tshom bu dgu'i dbus gser dngul zangs rdza sogs kyi bum pa mtshan ldan thog mar gu gul bdug oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li sogs bzla zhing / yungs dkar brab nang rgyun 'babs chu gtsang dri bzang btab pas sum gnyis bkang bar/ sle tre/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ shu dag dkar po/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ gser dngul/ byi ru/ mu tig mu men/ nas dkar/ gro/ sran dkar/ 'bras dkar/ til dkar/ grib chen la bla med lha gang rung gi drag po'i sbyin sreg thal ba/ 'bring la rgyas pa/ chung ngu la zhi ba/ btsan dug phran bu/ skyes dar ma g.yul du bsad pa'i rus phye shin tu zhib pa/ yungs dkar phran bu/ mgul chings dkar po zung la thun mong du srog bdun ku sha dang rma bya'i sgros kha brgyan/ dung chos sogs su dri bzang gi chu blugs pa khar bzhag steng rdo rje gzungs thag mdun du/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas sbrengs tshar tsam pa chu chang gis sbrus pa'i zlum gtor dkar po pad 'dab drug pa mar rgyan dang shas brgyan pa rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar lam dus rgyas 'bring gang rung bya/ bum pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li sogs kyis bsang / oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin bum pa bskyed la/ nang dri zhim po'i chus sum gnyis gang ba'i dbus su sman lnga yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā sogs nas aṃ a'i bar tshar gnyis brjod la zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i sogs/

rin po che lnga yongs su gyur pa las/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha nas ha k+ṣa'i bar tshar gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i sogs 'bru lnga yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dang nyi ma'i bar du hūm̐ rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon bskums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus rgyan drug dang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum mā ma kī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum ma dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dung chos kyi nang du pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas so so'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ so so la gnyis su med par thim pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣīñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing sogs rigs 'gre/

chu lhag ma yar lud pa las dung chos dang bum nang gi yab yum la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las a las sogs dkyil chog bzhin la/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs so so'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes gong rigs 'gre dang mchod pa so so'i sngags bsgyur/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil/ gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes sogs sh+lau ka gcig thams cad dngos po'i sogs sh+lau ka gcig gtor ma byin rlabs gtor bsngo bzhin/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa dang / oṃ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ an+da sogs nas kun 'grub shog bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin la nang mchod yid byung bstod pa rnams ma bshad pas lha chen brgyad po sogs rdo rje thugs ka dril bu chig brdung ngam/ thal sbyar gyis brjod kyang rung / khu tshur bsnol ba'i mtheb srin se gol phyir gtog oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gshegs/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng las 'od zer gzungs thag la zhon nas song bas rdo rje'i lte bas lhag pa'i lha la bskul ba tsam gyis de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas mchod yon gyi snod gang nas bum pa'i nang du babs/ bum pa'i nang gi mi bskyod pa'i dbu na mar song bas/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas kyang ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi dkar na ra ra 'dzag pas bum pa gang bar gyur zhes gzungs thag bzung la oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥhūm̐ zhes stong rtsa brgya sogs ci 'grub dang / oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs ci 'grub bzlas la 'jog pa na dung chos kyi lha 'od du zhu ba las mchod yon gyi snod gang ba bum par blug pas bum pa'i mi bskyod pa zhu bas mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab las grub pa'i chur gyur zhes blugs la/

sgrub thabs kyi rjes kyi rdo rje'i glu nas bkra shis bar rgyun gyi kha 'don bzhin no/ /de nas rang gzhan la/ zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed la/ drag po'i sbyang ba rnams spyi 'gre byas kyang chog ma byas kyang gzhung nas bshad pa med pas chad skyon du mi 'gyur/ bum pa rdor dril bcas thogs/ gdangs yod med gang rung gis phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs/ dpal mchog nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis sh+lau ka gsum mam/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyang brjod la oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs tshar gcig sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā sogs rnam 'joms byab khrus la oṃ de wa pi tsu'i sngags bcug nas bkru byabs bsrung gsum dang / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs tshar gsum/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum bsrung / /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ mtshungs med bla ma sogs bkra shis/ me tog char/ dril gsil gdangs yod med bcas bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di'i bum rdzas la btsan dug yod pas mig dang khar ha cang mang na mi legs shing / bum pa'ang kho rang 'dres med dang / me long la khrus byas kyang chog go /zhes sde dge zhus dag dbon po dge legs lhun grub nas 'di ltar gyis shig par lan kha shas bskul ba bzhin/ sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba 'dis steng grib sogs gdon rigs gtso bor smos pa'i grib rigs kun la phan pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ grib ma khrus sel gyi nyams len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
